title: How to Learn Tenses: The Simple Present

vocabulary.meaning_en: the verb form that shows time: present, past, future
vocabulary.example: The simple present is a tense.
Write the subject at the top of your page.

vocabulary.meaning_en: one key word that helps you remember a whole topic
vocabulary.example: The trigger word for the simple present is "truth".

vocabulary.meaning_en: an explanation of what something means
vocabulary.example: Write the definition under the trigger word.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a simple drawing that explains an idea
vocabulary.example: A timeline diagram helps you see the tense.

vocabulary.meaning_en: how the verb is written (e.g. add -s)
vocabulary.example: The form of the simple present: she walks.

vocabulary.meaning_en: how to make positive, negative and question sentences
vocabulary.example: Learn the structure: I work / I don't work / Do you work?

vocabulary.meaning_en: something that is true in the past, present and future
vocabulary.example: Birds fly. That is a truth.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something true now, but it can change
vocabulary.example: Who the prime minister is today is a fact, but it will change.
A habit is a repeated action.

vocabulary.meaning_en: how often something happens in a time period
vocabulary.example: Three times a week is the frequency.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something you do often and regularly
vocabulary.example: Reading before bed is my habit.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a helping verb (do/does for the simple present)
vocabulary.example: "Do" is the auxiliary verb in "Do you work?"
With the third person singular, add -s: she walks.

fine_lines.title: truth vs fact
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الحقيقة (truth) صحيحة دائمًا في الماضي والحاضر والمستقبل (Birds fly). الواقعة (fact) صحيحة الآن لكنها قد تتغير (اسم رئيس الوزراء الحالي).
fine_lines.explanation_en: A truth is true in the past, present and future (Birds fly). A fact is true now but can change (who the prime minister is).

fine_lines.title: repeated vs habit
fine_lines.explanation_ar: التكرار وحده لا يكفي ليصبح عادة. العادة = تكرار + تكرار منتظم (frequency) مثل three times a week.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Repeating something is not enough. A habit = repeated + often (a frequency) like three times a week.

examples.sentence: I called him three times this morning.
I go to the gym three times a week.

expressions.phrase: What is the best way to explain this with one word?
expressions.meaning_ar: ما أفضل طريقة لشرح هذا بكلمة واحدة؟
expressions.meaning_en: A good question to ask your teacher for a trigger word.
expressions.example: Teacher, what is the best way to explain this tense with one word?
I go to the gym three times a week.

grammar.title: A method to study any grammar topic
grammar.explanation_ar: اكتب: 1) الموضوع. 2) كلمة مفتاحية واحدة (تسألها لمعلمك) تكون جسرًا إلى الفهم. 3) التعريفات. 4) رسومًا توضيحية لأن عقلنا يفكر بالصور. 5) صيغة الفعل. 6) التركيب (مثبت، منفي، سؤال). 7) الحالات الخاصة.
grammar.explanation_en: Write: 1) the subject; 2) one trigger word (ask your teacher) – a bridge to understanding; 3) definitions; 4) diagrams, because our brain thinks in pictures; 5) the form of the verb; 6) the structure (positive, negative, question); 7) special cases.
examples: Subject: simple present → Trigger word: truth

grammar.title: Simple present = truth
grammar.explanation_ar: الكلمة المفتاحية للمضارع البسيط هي truth (حقيقة): شيء صحيح أمس واليوم وغدًا. I am a teacher. Birds fly.
grammar.explanation_en: The trigger word for the simple present is "truth": something true yesterday, today and tomorrow. I am a teacher. Birds fly.

grammar.title: Truth + repeated + often = habit
grammar.explanation_ar: نعرف أن الشيء حقيقة إذا كان صحيحًا ويتكرر بانتظام (frequency). لذلك نقول إن المضارع البسيط للعادات: العادة مبنية على التكرار والانتظام.
grammar.explanation_en: We know something is a truth if it is true and repeated often (with a frequency). That's why the simple present is for habits: a habit is based on repetition and frequency.
examples: I go to school five times a week.

grammar.title: Form: add -s for he / she / it
grammar.explanation_ar: مع الغائب المفرد (he, she, it) نضيف s للفعل: she walks, he goes. مع الباقي لا نضيف شيئًا: I walk, they walk.
grammar.explanation_en: With he / she / it, add -s to the verb: she walks, he goes. With the others, no -s: I walk, they walk.

grammar.title: Structure: positive, negative, question
grammar.explanation_ar: مثبت: I work. منفي: I do not (don't) work / She doesn't work. سؤال: نقدّم do/does على الفاعل: Do you work? وسؤال المعلومات: Where do you work?
grammar.explanation_en: Positive: I work. Negative: I do not (don't) work / She doesn't work. Question: put do/does before the subject: Do you work? Information question: Where do you work?

questions.question: James's trigger word for the simple present is ___.
Why should you draw diagrams?
choices: Because our brains think in pictures.
questions.explanation_en: Because our brains think in pictures.

questions.question: "I go to the gym three times a week." "Three times a week" is the ___.
The auxiliary verb for the simple present is ___.
